sentence: This project acquires an imaging platform that uses electron, ion and laser technologies to study battery materials, composites and biological structures.
This project uses high resolution satellite images of active volcanoes to find out whether warning signs appear before eruptions or landslides.
This project uses a scanning microwave resonator to find out why qubits lose energy and to build better qubits.
This project builds a system that runs one costly part of AI models, called context mixing, on its own devices.
This project builds microfluidic devices that include gut bacteria to find out how they affect intestinal organoids and drug absorption.
This project builds tools to forecast riverbank erosion and track water quality along rivers where frozen ground is thawing.
This project uses machine learning and data analysis on imaging and sequencing data to study differences among stem-cell-derived models.
This project builds a tool that compresses scientific data as it is produced, so storing and reading it takes less time.
This project traps barium ions, controls them with lasers and light, and links groups of ions using photons to scale up quantum computers.
This project measures how air motions and wind change the way snowflakes fall and settle, using cameras and other instruments at a field site.
This project builds a method that shows where ribosomes sit along single RNA molecules, to learn how they space out while making proteins.
This project watches gas giant planets as they form on wide orbits and designs specialized ways of observing them with a telescope.
This project tests whether Weyl semimetals can carry electrical signals in extremely small wires better than copper.
This project builds an assembly testbed and a digital twin to collect a public dataset on security problems in manufacturing.
This project builds software that uses machine learning to read a heart signal from patients after heart surgery and spot abnormal heart rhythms.
This project studies how taking part in an alliance of colleges shapes the goals of people from groups underrepresented in science over time.
This project builds statistical models that combine animal tracking data with citizen science sightings to learn how migratory species move.
